mapper.select: SELECT count(*) from LIQUIDITY_RISK_SUB WHERE ITEM_ID = #{itemId,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND SEND_STATUS in ('02','03')

select PROD_ID prodId, REG_CODE regCode, SOLUTIONS solutions, OCCUR_DATE occurDate, REPLY_DATE replyDate, DESCRIBED described, DISPOSE_RESULT disposeResult, REMARK remark, ORG_CODE orgCode, DEPT_CODE deptCode, CREATE_USER createUser, UPDATE_USER updateUser from LIQUIDITY_RISK_INFO where STATUS = 'E' and REPLY_DATE BETWEEN to_date(#{batchDateStart},'yyyy-MM-dd') AND to_date(#{batchDateEnd},'yyyy-MM-dd')
